messages:
maya: Heads-up — I started an intake for 'nova-7b' (community checkpoint). Posting initial bring-up + eval checklist here. Link: https://models.example/nova-7b

maya: TL;DR: want prioritization, quant sweep, canonical evals, and a short catalog blurb + launch copy. Can ops/infra give GPU availability for a canary? @tom @jen

rajar: +1. What's origin of this model (open weights, license)? any known hallucination issues?

maya: MIT-like permissive license, weights available. No major known safety incidents but limited evals so far. We'll run standard safety/toxicity checks.

sasha: Draft checklist (quick):
1) Sanity: load model, tokenization smoke test, generate a few prompts.
2) LM metrics: ppl on wikitext-103 + ppl on eval-1k prompt set.
3) Instruction-following: helpfulness eval on 200 prompts (human + automatic metrics).
4) Bench: per-token latency (FP16), peak memory, throughput at batch sizes {1,4,8}.
5) Quant sweep: GPTQ 4-bit and 8-bit PTQ; measure perf/quality delta.
6) Downstream suite: MMLU subset (20), GSM8K (100), and summarization rouge on CNN/DM sample.
7) Safety: toxicity check (Perspective), bias probes (gender/occupation), and jailbreak attempt set.
8) Regression: run against our regression prompts to detect quality drop.
9) Catalog blurb + scoring (latency/cost/accuracy).
10) Rollout plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto rollback on metric drop.

sasha: I'll open an eval job template. maya can you drop datasets + prompt sets paths?

maya: datasets: /data/wikitext-103, /data/regression-prompts/v3, /data/instruct-200, /data/mmlu-20. Prompts: see https://repos.internal/evals/nova-7b/prompts.md

tom: infra: we have 2 free A100s in eu-west-1 next week, otherwise earliest is 10d. For quick canary we'll need 1x V100 or 1x A100. Which is fine. I can allocate a GPU node for the quant sweep. @devops-bot can you create a sandbox cluster?

devops-bot: created cluster `nova-sandbox-eu` (k8s-rt-3). CI job template: `eval/nova-7b/smoke` queued.

rajar: For quant evaluation: please add per-task delta thresholds (e.g., MMLU drop <= 3 pts; GSM8K accuracy drop <= 2 pts absolute).

sasha: noted. Proposed thresholds: MMLU <=3, GSM8K <=2, Rouge-L <=1.5 absolute. Perf targets: int8 latency <= 1.3x fp16, mem reduction >= 50%.

maya: Good. Also add cost guidance: estimate token cost per 1k tokens (baseline fp16) so product PMs can decide.

sasha: Quick draft of catalog entry (feel free to iterate):
```
Model: nova-7b
Size: 7B
Origin: community checkpoint (MIT-ish)
Recommended modes: hosted (small latency-sensitive), dedicated GPU, private (if data governance needed)
Strengths: competitive instruction-following, strong summarization on short docs
Known limitations: limited long-context tuning, early-stage safety vetting
Performance (approx): FP16: 50ms/token (A100, batch=1). INT8 (PTQ): ~32ms/token. Memory reduction: ~55%.
Recommended quant: 8-bit PTQ for production; 4-bit for experimental latency-sensitive workloads with extra evals.
```

tom: Those perf numbers look optimistic — make sure to mark machine spec (A100 40GB). Otherwise ops will get surprised.

sasha: updated with machine spec.

jen: For release/announcement: suggest 2-stage comms: 1) internal eng-ml post with catalog link + evaluation summary, 2) product spotlight + short README for integration. Draft blurb: "Now available: nova-7b — a compact, open 7B model with strong instruction tuning for short-form tasks. See docs and try via our dev sandbox." emoji :tada:

maya: For rollout: propose canary traffic split controlled by latency + quality metrics. Canary 5% for 6 hours, compute moving avg on key metric (helpfulness score) and latency tail p95. If helpfulness drops >2 pts or p95 > 1.5x baseline, rollback automatically.

rajar: Add watchlist: hallucination rate, refusal rate. Also capture token distribution changes to catch degenerate sampling.

sasha: experiment plan for quant: run GPTQ-8, GPTQ-4, and 8-bit PTQ with per-layer clip. Baseline eval scripts: 
```bash
# quick smoke
./run_eval --model nova-7b --task lm_ppl --data /data/wikitext-103 --out out/ppl_fp16.json
# quant sweep
./run_quant --model nova-7b --algo gptq --bits 8 --out out/quant8
./run_quant --model nova-7b --algo gptq --bits 4 --out out/quant4
```

jen: timeline? Ops availability next week. If we start smoke + quant then, we can aim for internal catalog and eng announcement in 10-12 working days. Public docs after perf review.

maya: OK. Action items:
- sasha: kick off eval jobs + quant sweep (assigning now)
- tom: allocate node + ensure sandbox network egress disabled
- rajar: prepare threshold matrix and regression prompts
- jen: draft internal announcement copy and catalog stub; coordinate timing

sasha: will open PRs for eval jobs and catalog entry today.

tom: I'll tag infra ticket INF-3482 and attach node once provisioned.

devops-bot: CI status: `eval/nova-7b/smoke` started at 1775004720.

maya: thanks all. We'll reconvene in ~48h for first smoke results. :eyes:

jen: I'll prep release checklist (security review, docs link, PM approval).

sasha: quick note — add a regression gate in our deploy pipeline: block promotion if any regression test fails.

maya: captured. closing loop for now.
